purpose: Facts that reviewers stated in prose and that the registry needs as structured data (an entry that duplicates Official Records text, two entries that are one work, a first page the list gets wrong). Each fact is anchored by a phrase copied verbatim from the reviewer's own output; tests/sources-qc checks that every phrase occurs in the cited review or batch text, so nothing here is a new finding. A fact with no phrase that can be found is a test failure.
